title: Why I REFUSE to Debate Religious "Magic Tricks"! #shorts

top_liked.author: @Mr.FroggyFrog103
top_liked.text: I just can't help myself in giving my two cents regarding religious claims.  Trying to stop engaging but it's difficult.

top_liked.author: @BettyBoop-hm4hx
top_liked.text: You’re so right. When you really think about it, it’s not really much different than debating somebody over Santa Claus or the Easter bunny.

top_liked.author: @peteroutlaw7207
top_liked.text: I feel  it would  help  someone  with an open  mind, but I would  have a discussion  not a debate. If it were a debate  you would  have to  have facts  for both sides  and you should be  able  debate  the other  side . How do you  debate  a side which  doesn't  have facts?

top_liked.author: @paulmaggiar2596
top_liked.text: Religious conservatives have an invisible magic wand and they use it with impunity.  Point out to them the absurdities of certain beliefs and they will raise their magic wand and utter the magic words, "God in his almighty power can do it".  What can you say after that?

top_liked.author: @Robert_McGarry_Poems
top_liked.text: It's the... People know it's not true, but go along with it to see who is and is not "in the club" ... approach to a cult.

top_liked.author: @danielleaustin3515
top_liked.text: It's good to have an open mind, but not so open your brain falls out.

top_liked.author: @thecoolerx
top_liked.text:
Intelectual Honesty, in religión?
That is only possible if the words "have none"  goes at the Start of that sentence.

top_liked.author: @BalmoralBaal
top_liked.text: This is exactly my thought and action. I do not undestand the need to debate at this point.
